info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/kling-image/v3/image-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/kling-image/v3/image-to-image queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Generate images from a reference image using Kling V3 Standard model.

Image-to-image generation with optional element control (face).
Resolution up to 2K with multiple aspect ratio options.

KlingImageV3ImageToImageInput.description: Request model for Kling V3 Image-to-Image Generation.

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation. Max 2500 characters.
examples: Transform to deep winter, heavy snow covering all surfaces, bare frozen trees, overcast sky, footprints in fresh powder, cold blue color grade
prompt.title: Prompt

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

image_url.description:
Reference image for image-to-image generation.

Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s
image_url.title: Image Url

elements.title: Elements
elements.description: Optional: Elements (characters/objects) to include in the image for face control.

KlingImageV3ImageToImageInput.title: V3ImageToImageRequest

KlingImageV3ImageToImageOutput.description: Output model for Kling V3 Image Generation.
KlingImageV3ImageToImageOutput.title: I2IV3ImageOutput

ElementInput.description:
Element input for image generation with face/character control.

Create an element by providing frontal_image_url (and optionally reference_image_urls).
All fields are optional - provide what you have available.

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

frontal_image_url.title: Frontal Image Url
frontal_image_url.description: The frontal image of the element (main view). Optional.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
reference_image_urls.description: Additional reference images from different angles. 0-3 images supported. Optional.

ElementInput.title: ElementInput

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
